_about: Totals are given per storey band (byDensity: 1-3, 4+, both); lotsWithFit and byTypology at the top level are both bands together. Coverage of the merged layout library (every kept layout) on Vancouver candidate lots, written by Code for the landing page from the merged coverage files. A lot counts as reached when at least one kept layout fits it (every hard gate; the layout inside the lot's buildable area, height and the zone's FAR). Counted from the files; nothing typed.

engine.note: layouts from the full generator run (standard and high density, 4511 kept layouts), matched lot by lot
